title: SREV-041 api copy box name

audit_contract.description: API: Api_CopyBoxNameFromUser | data: {"input": "user WCHAR* box name", "output": "kernel-owned BOXNAME_COUNT WCHAR buffer"} | callers: Process_Api_Start, Process_Api_QueryInfo, Conf_Api_IsBoxEnabled

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: box name input is a user pointer and must be copied before Box_IsValidName reads it
box name must be readable as BOXNAME_COUNT - 2 WCHARs with WCHAR alignment
box name must contain a NUL terminator before the BOXNAME_COUNT - 2 payload cap
overlong unterminated box name is invalid and must not be truncated
local copied box name must pass Box_IsValidName before use
